Murphy Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Clorox Company (CLX) by 54.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Murphy Capital Management Inc bought 3,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.48% with the market. The institutional investor held 8,548 shares of the specialty chemicals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.27M, up from 5,548 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Murphy Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Clorox Company for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $15.20 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.38% or $1.64 during the last trading session, reaching $117.4. About 1.78M shares traded or 44.13% up from the average. The Clorox Company (NYSE:CLX) has declined 7.70% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.25% the S&P500.
